title: Messaging
description: How many messages a user may send, and the key pair push notifications are signed with.

sendMaxPerWindow.label: Max messages
sendMaxPerWindow.description: Messages a single user may send within the send window before being throttled.

sendWindowSeconds.label: Send window (seconds)
sendWindowSeconds.description: Time window during which sent messages are counted.

contactMaxPerWindow.label: Max new conversations
contactMaxPerWindow.description: Conversations a single user may open within the contact window before being throttled.

contactWindowSeconds.label: Contact window (seconds)
contactWindowSeconds.description: Time window during which opened conversations are counted.

error.title: Could not save
error.description: Check the values and try again.

push.regenerateHint: Generate a fresh pair. Every existing push subscription is bound to the old key and will be dropped.

copied.title: Copied
copied.description: The public key was copied to your clipboard.

copyFailed.title: Copy failed
copyFailed.description: Could not copy to the clipboard.

aside.publicKeyHint: Browsers use this key to verify push messages from this instance. {{count}} subscription(s) are currently bound to it.

overrideDescription: Paste a pair generated with `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys`. Both keys are required.

keysReplaced.title: VAPID keys updated
keysReplaced.description: Removed {{count}} push subscription(s) bound to the old key. Affected users must re-enable push on their devices.

errors.replaceFailed: Could not update the VAPID keys.

confirmWarning.title: Replace VAPID keys?
confirmWarning.description: This deletes all {{count}} push subscription(s). Every user must re-enable push notifications on each device.

confirmFinal.title: Are you sure?
confirmFinal.description: This cannot be undone. Users will stop receiving push notifications until they turn the toggle back on.
